summary: Seattle, software developer, extensive experience in offshoring and outsourcing, libertarian beliefs, strong opinions on electronic voting and election integrity, active in political lobbying, has worked in healthcare IT, advocates for single-payer healthcare, interested in nutrition and health (following a "troglodiet"), has a background in print manufacturing software, critical of corporate practices and neoconservative pundits, involved in grassroots political activism, has a family structure that includes solo parenting, engaged in open-source software projects, values transparency and accountability in government.
